text:
Sam: Who's up for a low-stakes compiler open-mic tonight in #random? bring your worst semver jokes and YAML horror stories :microphone:
Alex: I'm in. I'll bring a kazoo and an off-by-one poem.
Maria: Count me. New stage name: SegFault Sinatra.
Jordan: Can we start with a 30s rule so no one rails on the parser for 15 minutes? :sweat_smile: 
DevBot: Reminder: please don't paste prod configs. Bot will gently nudge if it detects secrets.
Alex: (opens with) "There once was a patch in my version, it bumped the major by coercion..." :notes: 
Sam: Bonus points if you can rhyme 'concurrency' with 'latency'.
Maria: I have a YAML haiku:
```yaml
indentation
says it loves you with two spaces
then breaks your build
```
Jordan: That slaps. I'll follow with my semver breakup song:
```
I used to be 1.2.3
You made me 2.0 unexpectedly
Now I'm a 404 in your changelog
```
Alex: applause emoji :clap: :clap:
Sam: Poll: do we want a theme? "Bad semver confessions" vs "YAML confessional". React with :one: or :two:
Maria: reacts with :one:
Jordan: reacts with :two:
DevBot: Reaction tally: 1️⃣=1, 2️⃣=1 — tie! starting rock-paper-scissors tiebreaker in 3...2...1...
Alex: Rock. (I mean, semver rock) :rock:
Maria: Paper (I covered your major bump) :paper:
Sam: Paper wins. Theme set: Bad semver confessions.
Jordan: Confession: I once merged a PR that changed a `patch` to `major` because of a stray find-and-replace. It haunted my dreams. :skull:
Maria: Storytime? details? :eyes:
Jordan: long story short: pipeline caught it, QA yelled, I bought donuts. Learned to `git reflog` and to never trust regex for versioning.
Alex: Moral of the night: semver responsibly, YAML with candles, and always lint before you love. :heart:
DevBot: Nightly reminder: if you put a vendor in the repo, add a license file. Also consider automated semver checks.
Sam: Thanks all — same time next week? maybe themed costumes. :tada:
Maria: I'm bringing a poncho — YAML no tears allowed.
Alex: I'll practice a kazoo solo. goodnight!
Jordan: night!
DevBot: Session archived. Use `#random` to revisit the recordings (just kidding, no recordings) :ghost:
